en: Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone city street lined with four‑ to five‑story masonry buildings featuring late‑19th‑century European architecture. A horse-drawn tram runs on tracks in the foreground, with several pedestrians and carts along the street. Visible signage on the façades is in German, including a building labeled "Hotel Kronprinz". Overhead are utility poles and wires, and shop signs hang from many of the houses.
